run_validate_translation: run the script to validate a translation language against English sections using --language flag
run_load_sections: run load_sections to extract section names from a language toctree YAML file
review_load_sections: review the load_sections function that parses _toctree.yml and returns a set of section local names
refactor_validate_translation: refactor the validate_translation script to support multiple language comparisons at once
test_load_sections: test the load_sections function with a sample language code to verify YAML parsing
